integrity: Proof and executable finite cross-check supplied; no external scientific validation or originality certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Requires both clique factors to have order at least two. Determines the maximum number of disjoint maximal geodesics, not the number of optimal packings. Equivalence to older general induced-star packing formulations is a residual literature risk.
title: Sharp geodesic packing of rectangular rook graphs by six local bricks
